author: Amongenesis
quote: Terrible GTA game, Gacha games have better story's.  They have toned down or removed any violence against certain protected groups.  It takes 7hrs to get into the story, properly.  The 2 main characters and their romantic relationship while "optional", I just found them both to be unlikeable.  Google rockstar developers photo and you'll see why this game is the worst in the series.
